core_obligations: Reduce: local finite presentation (resp. local finite type) is \'etale local on source and target, so assume $B$ and $Y$ are affine schemes (proof lines 939-946).
Chart: $|X| \to |Y|$ is open, so choose an affine scheme $U$ and an \'etale morphism $U \to X$ with $U \to Y$ surjective (proof lines 946-950).
Conclude $q$ locally of finite presentation (resp. type) by the scheme-side permanence lemma applied to the resulting diagram of schemes (proof lines 950-953).
proof_roadmap: Use \'etale locality to make $B$ and $Y$ affine.
Use openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ to get a surjective \'etale affine chart of $X$.
difficulty_reason: The proof carries out the \'etale reduction explicitly: locality lemmas make the question \'etale local on $B$ and $Y$, so $B, Y$ may be taken affine; openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ produces an affine scheme $U$ \'etale over $X$ with $U \to Y$ surjective, and the scheme-side permanence lemma concludes (the author also notes the lemma is a special case of lemma-curiosity).
